text: Shell-and-tube heat exchangers shall comply with TEMA (class C or R by service) and the pressure vessel code. Plate heat exchangers shall have 10 % surface margin over the calculated duty with fouling factors per the datasheet and shall provide space for tube or plate removal. Seawater-cooled exchangers shall use titanium or higher-alloy plates or tubes; the fouling / cleanliness basis shall be the cleanliness factor of the condenser design where applicable.
